adequacy_evidence.quote: This is a qualification: the nonzero-map support rule is an operational coverage assumption, sign symmetry is not independently verified, and max-T global-null calibration alone does not establish strong FWER under every possible partial-null configuration.

hypothesis_conclusion.quote: In the 54-person NARPS equal-indifference group, the supplied gain-effect estimates do **not** support a positive response in vmPFC.
